decisions.reason: Although it fits the maritime customer base, submarine interior lighting is a distant and very niche extension and the weaker website presence suggests lower strategic commitment than the firm's core lighting lines.
A medical examination light builds on the firm's lighting expertise, serves professional institutional users, and having its own page indicates a serious market offer worth continuing.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires are a strong fit with the firm's industrial customers and engineering strengths, and the multi-model line points to a committed growth product.
The designer task light was a relaunch of a previously popular product, so it likely has proven demand and relatively low risk compared with a brand-new concept.
